A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 93-page survey. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish matching scientific content, equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither version contains an appendix.

before.justification: v2 reports a literature survey. Tables 1–2 compile existing models and datasets, and Figure 11 reproduces a VBench leaderboard. The empirical examples are attributed to prior work; no original empirical study is reported.

after.justification: v3 likewise reports literature synthesis and results attributed to existing work, including the VBench leaderboard and ConsistI2V comparison. It reports no original experimental, simulation, user-study, or data-analysis outcomes.

M1.justification: The architectures, diffusion procedures, guidance algorithms, and training objectives surveyed in Section 2 are identical. No method component is introduced or revised.

E1.justification: Neither version reports training or evaluation conducted for this survey. The surveyed datasets in Table 2 and application coverage in Sections 4–5 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Neither version evaluates a proposed method against baselines. The comparison membership in Table 1, the reproduced VBench leaderboard, and qualitative examples is unchanged.

E3.justification: The training procedures described in Section 3.2 and evaluation metrics and protocols summarized in Section 3.3 are identical.

E4.justification: The qualitative comparisons, including Figure 20’s ConsistI2V example, are unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, sensitivity study, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: There are no additions or revisions to run counts, seeds, uncertainty estimates, or significance-testing information.

E6.justification: The numerical summaries in Tables 1–2, leaderboard entries in Figure 11, and reported qualitative findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 2’s mathematical definitions, objectives, diffusion equations, and derivations are identical. No theoretical assumption, proof, or mathematical correction is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction’s contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same survey scope and scientific claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations of model capabilities and the discussions of computational demands, temporal consistency, physical realism, and ethical limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, model and dataset specifications, and code/resource access information are unchanged. Only the paper’s own arXiv-version hyperlink changes with its stamp.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference entries, and positioning relative to earlier surveys are identical.

P1.justification: v3 replaces MM/YYYY with 09/2025 in the journal header and updates the first-page arXiv stamp from v2, 20 Sep 2025, to v3, 10 Feb 2026. All remaining wording and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Rendered page bodies match throughout, including figures, tables, captions, equations, and their placement. The header and arXiv-stamp text edits do not change the layout.

improvement.justification: v3 fills the publication-date placeholder and updates the arXiv stamp. The survey’s evidence, coverage, explanations, figures, and tables remain identical, so these administrative edits do not meaningfully change overall paper quality.
